summary: Verified two-tab Task Management split (Founder / Designer tabs) for the current spec. Backend regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py — 29/29 pytest pass (no code changes needed; existing suite already covers founder-can-create-both-types, assigned_to flip on task_type switch, designer locked fields, founder->designer sync, overdue, dashboard, auth). Frontend Playwright E2E: FOUNDER /tasks shows two tabs with data-testid tab-founder-tasks (default, active) and tab-designer-tasks; Founder-tab columns = [Date, Task Name, Task Category, Objective/Brief, Priority, Est. Completion Time (hrs), Current Status, Delay Reason, Review Notes / Next Action, Output, Actions]; Designer-tab columns = [Date, Task Name, Client / Work Type, Objective/Brief, Priority, Manager Deadline (hrs), Designer Committed Time (hrs), Current Status, Delay Reason, Output Link, Review Notes / Changes, Actions]. Add buttons read 'New Founder Task' and 'New Designer Task' respectively; task-task_type-select is absent in both dialogs; dialog header subtext correctly shows 'Founder Task · assigned to Founder' and 'Designer Task · assigned to Designer'. No 'All Owners' / 'All Types' filter; only date/status/priority/category remain. Numeric inputs: committed_time and manager_deadline both type=number (hours); cells render 'X hrs'. Switching tabs re-fetches and only the matching task_type is listed (founder-created founder task does NOT appear in Designer tab). Founder->Designer sync verified: founder-created Designer task appears in DESIGNER login. DESIGNER login: founder tab absent, only designer board; no delete buttons; EDIT dialog has name/brief/review disabled and committed/status/delay/output editable — matches execution-only spec. Cleanup: TEST_tab* tasks deleted via API.

issues: Pluralization: '1 hrs' is grammatically off (should be '1 hr'). Minor cosmetic.

Console warning: 'The specified value 2026-10-02 cannot be parsed, or is out of range' — emptyTask() seeds manager_deadline with an ISO date string while the input is type=number. Suggest initializing manager_deadline to '' (empty) in emptyTask() to silence the warning.
React warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby on DialogContent. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility.

action_items: (Minor) Fix emptyTask() so manager_deadline defaults to '' (empty string) instead of an ISO date — avoids 'cannot be parsed' console warning on the numeric input.
(Minor) Pluralize hour label: show 'hr' when value == 1, else 'hrs'.
(Minor) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to task dialog for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: Tasks.js: `tab` state drives both the GET filter (task_type param) and TaskForm `mode`; column arrays and fieldList diverge cleanly per mode — matches spec. No task-type dropdown.
TaskForm makeEmpty() correctly sets task_type/assigned_to from `mode`. Designer users default to designer mode because Tasks() initializes tab via isFounder.
Backend create_task: founder keeps body task_type (Founder/Designer, fallback Founder Task); designer forced to Designer Task — defense-in-depth preserved.
Backend update_task: founder changing task_type flips assigned_to; designer PUT whitelisted to {status, committed_time, delay_reason, output_link} — verified by pytest.
manager_deadline and committed_time still typed Optional[str] on backend; frontend sends numeric string. Consider Optional[float] for stricter validation, but functional.
emptyTask() seeds manager_deadline with ISO date yet the input is numeric — small cleanup needed to avoid console warning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on two-tab split, columns, add-form, sync, designer restrictions

Key testids: tab-founder-tasks, tab-designer-tasks (founder only), add-task-button, task-dialog, task-name-input, task-brief-input, task-committed-input (type=number hours), manager_deadline is also numeric hours (no testid), task-status-select, task-delay-input, task-output-input, task-review-input, task-save-button, edit-task-<id>, delete-task-<id> (founder only). Filters: filter-date/filter-status/filter-priority/filter-category only. Backend pytest file remains /app/backend/tests/test_ops_api.py — all 29 pass against the live preview.
